nodes.long_description:
1.Replace bedding by changing pillowcases, mattress covers, and comforters
2.Separate trash from recyclables and dispose of them separately
3. replenish disposables, towels, tissues, shampoo, bottled water and tea bags
nodes.short_description:
It improves the ability of people with developmental disabilities to manage hotel rooms by repeatedly mastering the sequence of changing bedding, separating and replenishing supplies in virtual reality.
Even those with disabilities who have difficulty using controllers can play the game through hand tracking 
The hotel room management content is made to be able to play the game through hand tracking.
